E.g., using Algorithm 3 8: Create proxy data from unlabeled data S proxy := {(x, fbg (x), g) : (x, g) ∈ U }. proxy 9: Define proxy regret using unlabeled data: ∀f ∈ F, Regretproxy (f, g) := Loss(f, Sg ). 10: end for 11: Solve the following min-max problem:  fb = argminf ∈F maxg∈G αg Regretemp (f, g) + (1 − αg )Regretproxy (f, g) . 12: return fb Note, we have presented the algorithm in a general manner without specific data dependent choices of αg and the choice of the closest dense groups.
